title: Jyotipunj
author: Narendra Modi
summary: Sixteen portraits of the RSS workers who shaped Modi, most of them unknown outside Gujarat. Shown here as a banyan-tree map, a 1889–2015 timeline, the routes people took into Gujarat, and a card for each person.

title: Perversion of India's Political Parlance
author: Sita Ram Goel
summary: Goel argues that India's Left/Right, secular/communal vocabulary came from Soviet Communism rather than the freedom struggle. Shown here as six word pairs, four “languages of imperialism” side by side, a 1857–1959 timeline and how the vocabulary spread.

title: Hindu View of Christianity and Islam
author: Ram Swarup
summary: Swarup compares Christianity and Islam from the standpoint of Hindu yoga. He groups them as “prophetic” religions, with one jealous God and one messenger, against “yogic” spirituality. Shown here as an eight-row comparison, a family tree of the prophetic creeds, a timeline of Western Islamic studies and Vyasa's five planes of mind.
